clips.title: 波音CEO说产量爬坡：实际交付却砍半，差距有多大？

subtitles.en: Yes, Kelly Orteburg is here at Farnborough, the CEO of Boeing.
subtitles.zh: 是的，凯利·奥特伯格在范堡罗，波音公司的CEO。

subtitles.en: Great to see you. Good to see you. Thanks for taking the time.
subtitles.zh: 很高兴见到你。谢谢抽出时间。

subtitles.en: Look, Kelly, you're two years in. Nearly two years in. Yeah.
subtitles.zh: 凯利，你上任快两年了。

subtitles.en: ACO of Boeing. Company feels like it's in much better shape.
subtitles.zh: 波音CEO。公司状况好多了。

subtitles.en: The share price is well off its lows. You take the whole load of boxes.
subtitles.zh: 股价远高于低点，你承担了很多责任。
en_highlights: share price is well off its lows

subtitles.en: At the priorities beginning to change, it feels like a company that's shifting to offense, to getting on the front foot.
subtitles.zh: 优先级开始变化，公司转向进攻，主动出击。

subtitles.en: Well, we're turning the corner. I tell my team, we haven't quite finished turning the corner.
subtitles.zh: 我们正在好转。我告诉团队，还没完全好转。
en_highlights: haven't quite finished turning the corner

subtitles.en: We've got more work to do, but I am pleased with the progress so far.
subtitles.zh: 还有更多工作要做，但我对进展感到满意。

subtitles.en: We're ramping up production across many of our product lines.
subtitles.zh: 我们正在多个产品线上提高产量。

subtitles.en: Markets are very strong. Our backlog is very, very strong.
subtitles.zh: 市场非常强劲，我们的订单积压非常强劲。

subtitles.en: So our story is really focusing on executing that backlog.
subtitles.zh: 所以我们的重点就是执行这些积压订单。

subtitles.en: Okay. The administration, the White House, has given you massive support over the last 18 months.
subtitles.zh: 过去18个月，白宫给了你们大力支持。
zh_highlights: 白宫给了你们大力支持

subtitles.en: The president certainly had your back.
subtitles.zh: 总统肯定支持你们。

subtitles.en: Do you think the company would be where it is now?
subtitles.zh: 您认为没有这种支持，公司还能有今天的进展吗？

subtitles.en: That kind of progress that you've made without that kind of support.
subtitles.zh: 那种支持带来的进步。

subtitles.en: Well, I think the execution focus is really on us to go improve our overall performance.
subtitles.zh: 我认为执行力的提升主要靠我们自己改善整体表现。

subtitles.en: Build trust with our stakeholders, restore trust with the regulator.
subtitles.zh: 与利益相关者建立信任，恢复监管机构的信任。

subtitles.en: And I think that's more what Boeing has done for themselves.
subtitles.zh: 这更多是波音自己做到的。

subtitles.en: The president has been very helpful in sales campaigns.
subtitles.zh: 总统在销售活动中帮了大忙。
zh_highlights: 总统在销售活动中帮了大忙

subtitles.en: Balancing trade, the best way to do that is by a bunch of airplanes.
subtitles.zh: 平衡贸易的最佳方式就是卖出大量飞机。

subtitles.en: And so we've been a beneficiary of that. He's been very helpful to the whole aerospace industry.
subtitles.zh: 因此我们从中受益，他对整个航空业帮助很大。

subtitles.en: So you're in a good place right now. So what's now?
subtitles.zh: 所以你们现在处境不错。接下来呢？

clip_research.source_claim: We're turning the corner. I tell my team, we haven't quite finished turning the corner. We've got more work to do, but I am pleased with the progress so far. We're ramping up production across many of our product lines. Markets are very strong. Our backlog is very, very strong.
clip_research.public_baseline: Boeing delivered only 348 commercial aircraft in 2024, well below Airbus's 766. The FAA capped 737 MAX production at 38 per month in early 2024, later raised to 42 in October 2025. The company faced a major strike in late 2024 and ongoing quality issues.
clip_research.surprise_gap: The CEO's optimistic 'turning the corner' narrative contrasts with the public baseline of low deliveries, production caps, and labor strife. The claim of 'ramping up production' is not yet reflected in 2024 delivery numbers.

data_driven_lessons.source: KC桌面-视频号动态数据明细.csv, 114 rows, July 2026 local analysis
winning_patterns: 机构/人物权威 + 具体数字/资产 + 强问题，例如 高盛王逸：4-5万亿城市更新会拖住楼市吗
大机构/名人 + 被逼/陷阱/真相/转向 等张力词，例如 野村辜朝明：日本央行被逼到墙角
具体数据 + 政策动作疑问，例如 6月PMI释放积极信号，政府会加码吗
反常识判断 + 下一步条件，例如 低估值可能是价值陷阱，需等待政策转向消费
中国相关议题更容易获得点击，但表达要落在政策、需求、信心、估值、产业升级这些正向框架
外资或海外权威给出对中国更积极的判断时，反差本身就是主标题，不要埋在摘要里
让观众产生单一强反应：居然如此、终于有人说、他说的是真的吗、原来中国优势在这里
大实话角度来自表达者身份与观点反差；言行反差角度必须有公开动作或披露支撑
涉及中国比较优势时，优先把外国企业被迫调整、海外权威改口或中国优势被低估写成冲突
avoid_patterns: 过长的新闻句，尤其是 24 字以上还塞多个从句
只有 策略/机会/影响/前瞻/市场/风险 这类泛词，没有具体对象或张力
美国宏观泛标题如果没有美联储/鲍威尔等强锚点，点击明显弱
纯描述式标题，例如 某市场短期风险与长期催化剂，缺少问题和冲突
经济危机/金融危机/崩盘/崩溃 这类过硬负面财经词
把事实换成疑问号但没有反差，例如 回报路径在哪、未来如何、能否实现
陌生英文人名或机构全称占据第一行，却没有告诉观众这个人为什么值得听
把 Bloomberg LP 等来源或公司法律后缀误当成采访对象
没有公开证据却暗示嘉宾撒谎、操纵或言行不一
